content.short: GTokenTool is a codeless token management platform to create, deploy and manage cryptocurrencies, with cross-chain instant swaps, batch transfers and batch account generation.
content.description: GTokenTool provides a visual interface that lets users quickly create, deploy and manage their own cryptocurrencies without writing code. Beyond core token creation, it includes features such as cross-chain instant swaps, batch transfers, batch account generation, and market value management across multiple networks. The platform is designed to expand with future offerings, including token pre-sales, token locking and unlocking, and contract auditing services, to support developers and creators throughout the token lifecycle.
content.meta: GTokenTool offers an interface to create and manage cryptocurrencies without coding. Discover GTokenTool and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
